items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: He described Vanderbilt when he was piloting out of the boat and leaving my maids behind.

ctx.x: Did the blind men have any answer too much to it?

Guitar shit, naturally. I remember one was called Blind Tone. It was sensational. First time I actually saw somebody who was really singing the blues, it was well known. Everybody was so happy they'd come from blocks around. The news was spreading inside of fifteen to twenty minutes of that, two, three hundred people gathered around. The first time I saw somebody, I had the nuts through the crowd to see if it was exciting. Sitting down on a box or a crate with this old blind man. Didn't seem to be so old, maybe…
You never were on the stage, huh Danny? I mean acting. Who's that?
